methodology.transcript_scope: full transcript; not limited to overlapping speech
methodology.context_policy: Each response turn is assessed with up to 5 preceding different-speaker turns.
methodology.moderator_policy: Moderation, panelist introductions, summaries, follow-up questions, and repetition without a stance are neutral; substantive anchor stances are classified normally. Host identity is not used for classification.
methodology.overlap_policy: Overlap and interruption are not evidence of stance by themselves.
methodology.neutral_policy: Neutral candidates are counted in the candidate summary but omitted from interaction records; uncertain records are retained.
methodology.target_policy: Target is a specific earlier turn; no reverse inference. Response timestamp determines subtopic mapping.
limitations: ASR errors can affect stance and exact quote matching.
The analysis does not infer intent, ideology, bias, or factual correctness.

episode_summary.ratio_note: Agreement family = agreement + partial_agreement; disagreement family = disagreement + counterargument. Neutral turns are omitted; uncertain cases are excluded from ratio denominators.
